subject.title: fix(ui): add timeout to control-ui bootstrap config fetch

question: Should the Control UI treat bootstrap-config responses taking longer than 15 seconds as failed and continue with defaults?
rationale: The implementation is correct, but choosing a fixed deadline determines when existing slow deployments silently lose routing, identity, version, terminal, or authentication metadata; repository history and tests cannot establish the intended compatibility boundary.

options.title: Accept the 15-second fallback
options.body: Keep the patch as written because the endpoint is same-origin, the metadata is optional, and the supplied proof shows a 14-second response still succeeds.

options.title: Choose a different deadline
options.body: Request an owner-approved timeout value or timeout-composition rule before merge if known slow proxy deployments need more headroom.

options.title: Pause the timeout change
options.body: Leave the fetch unbounded until maintainers can define a broader Control UI network-deadline policy.

recommendation.title: Accept the 15-second fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the patch as written because the endpoint is same-origin, the metadata is optional, and the supplied proof shows a 14-second response still succeeds.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person to the Control UI application and configuration architecture where the timeout policy belongs.
